theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (θ₀ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)), 0 < θ₀ → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(W k).measure) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure P)))) → ∀ (K O : Set (Euclidean N)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), IsCompact K → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → O ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 → ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ O) < c → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, (W k).weight K < c
